description: Use it only after the person chose one yacht from a search_yachts or get_yacht answer, gave their days and said yes to holding it: ask them before you call it. Pass its page link exactly as that answer returned it as id, with from and to. It needs the person signed in. It holds the yacht here for a few days at the price it answers and asks the desk to confirm with the supplier: tell them it is not confirmed or paid. requested_from_desk means nothing is held yet and the desk answers by email.

id.description: The yacht page link (an absolute URL on this site), exactly as a search, best_deals or get returned it.

notes.description: What the person wants the desk to know, in their words (at most 2000 characters).

serviceMode.description: How the yacht is sold, in the words get answered, when it is sold more than one way.

name: request_hold

bookingRef.description: The booking's reference, for get_booking_status and cancel_booking.

discountPct.description: The AI booking discount taken, in percent.

holdUntil.description: When the hold lapses, ISO time.

listPrice.description: The price before the AI booking discount.

nextStep.description: What happens now, in words to tell the person.

status.description: option_requested: held here, the desk confirms with the supplier; requested_from_desk: nothing is held, the desk answers; already_requested: the person asked for this in the last day.

supplier.description: Always requested here: only the desk can confirm with the supplier.

title: Hold it for the person
